proposals.before: That same year the emperor instructed the ritual officials that since the investiture ceremony would not be held, there was no need to prepare the full ceremonial regalia, whose manufacture would take considerable time.
proposals.after: That same year the emperor instructed the ritual officials that since the ceremony for investing the crown prince would not be held, there was no need to prepare the full ceremonial regalia, whose manufacture would take considerable time.
proposals.reason: Chinese 冊立皇太子典禮 specifies the crown-prince investiture; the idiomatic 'investiture ceremony' omits that referent.

proposals.before: The Defender-general of the State's ceremonial guard comprised one dark-apricot umbrella, one blue fan, and six flag-spears.
proposals.after: The Defender-general of the State's ceremonial guard comprised one apricot-yellow umbrella, one blue fan, and six flag-spears.
proposals.reason: Chinese 杳黃傘 is a corruption of 杏黃傘; s0260 revises the same item to apricot-yellow 杏黃傘.

proposals.before: Defender-general of the State ceremonial guard: one dark-apricot umbrella, one blue fan, and six flag-spears.
proposals.after: Defender-general of the State ceremonial guard: one apricot-yellow umbrella, one blue fan, and six flag-spears.
proposals.reason: Chinese 杳黃傘 is a corruption of 杏黃傘; parallel revision in s0260 uses 杏黃傘.

proposals.before: A prince's primary consort ranked with a Princess of Imperial Title, except that her curved-handle umbrella was red; four maidservants accompanied her at court.
proposals.after: A prince's primary consort ranked with an Imperial Clan Princess, except that her curved-handle umbrella was red; four maidservants accompanied her at court.
proposals.reason: 固倫公主 is rendered Imperial Clan Princess at s0271; Princess of Imperial Title invents a different title for the same Chinese term.

proposals.before: A prince's primary consort was accorded the same as a Princess of Imperial Title; only the curved-handle umbrella used red, with four attending maidservants at court.
proposals.after: A prince's primary consort was accorded the same as an Imperial Clan Princess; only the curved-handle umbrella used red, with four attending maidservants at court.
proposals.reason: 固倫公主 should match the established Imperial Clan Princess rendering used at s0271.

proposals.before: Ceremonial guard for imperial sons-in-law: an imperial son-in-law of a Princess of Imperial Title received two red staffs, one red umbrella, two large and small blue fans, ten flag spears, and two leopard-tail spears.
proposals.after: Ceremonial guard for imperial sons-in-law: an imperial son-in-law of an Imperial Clan Princess received two red staffs, one red umbrella, two large and small blue fans, ten flag spears, and two leopard-tail spears.
proposals.reason: 固倫公主額駙 must use Imperial Clan Princess, not Princess of Imperial Title, to match s0271.

proposals.before: Ceremonial guard for imperial sons-in-law: for an imperial son-in-law of a Princess of Imperial Title, two red staffs, one red umbrella, two large and small blue fans, ten flag spears, and two leopard-tail spears.
proposals.after: Ceremonial guard for imperial sons-in-law: for an imperial son-in-law of an Imperial Clan Princess, two red staffs, one red umbrella, two large and small blue fans, ten flag spears, and two leopard-tail spears.
proposals.reason: 固倫公主 should match Imperial Clan Princess as at s0271.

decisions.reason: The literal field should follow the explicit revision at s0260 and render the umbrella 杏黃, apricot-yellow.
